flawed_step: 0035 | The claim that every nonempty Cij equals δ(Si) and is a bond is false.
counterexample: Let G=K2,2 with bipartition {s1,s2} and {t1,t2}, and take S={s1,s2}, T={t1,t2}. Each induced subgraph G[S] and G[T] has two singleton components. Then C11={s1t1}, but δ({s1})={s1t1,s1t2}. Moreover, C11 is not a cut-set: removing one edge from the 4-cycle K2,2 leaves the graph connected.
assessment_summary: Lines 0023–0033 correctly partition the cut into component-pair edge sets. The first failure is line 0035: an individual nonempty component-pair set need not itself be a cut or equal δ(Si), so the claimed decomposition into minimal cuts is not established.
